question: By how many percentage points did the surface fluorine mass ratio fall through the Cyrene-based separation?

door_refusals.why: your own words contain number(s) ['12.35'] — a number must come from the document, in digits or in words
moves: move each number into a quote run: {"quote": "<exact characters>", "atom": "<id>"}
or compute it in a sql run (counts, sums, conversions)
or say it without a number ("several", "a", "each")

door_refusals.why: the text "'%.2f'" puts digits into the value "PRINTF('%.2f', 12.49 - 0.14) AS drop" — a value may only carry numbers read from atoms
moves: read the number from the atom that holds it (e.g. regexp_extract over its text) instead of typing it
for a unit factor or physical constant, read it from consts: (SELECT value FROM consts WHERE id = 'K.per_kilo')
0, 1 and 100 are allowed as written; constants in WHERE/ON (choosing) are always allowed
